name: Choice repair off vs on, JevK5 9B cascade
notes: Does telling a choosing model why its last step failed help? Plan section 8; research plan item 40; issue #112. One model (JevK5 9B, its own letter interface: cascade), the same seeds, island, culture, rules and sampling; the arms differ only in `repair` (the simulator's exact reason, once, in the next choice scene and in an escalated full plan). Pre-registered outcomes, in order: model step failure rate (model_steps_failed / model steps), failure loops, repaired first steps ok vs failed, requests per chit-day (the cost), then discoveries, population, starved. A repair that only trades one failure for another shows as a high repaired_steps_failed share. The decision bench cannot answer this (its scenes never follow a failed choice). Runs on the RTX 5090 after the JevK5-vs-Gemma study; blind until the report is frozen. Shared-world systems as in that study (beliefs, last-keeper reminders, library hints) are on in both arms.
